tool.name: review.acme.example
notes: Drafts are pasted into the tool by the user. The skill never submits.

references: Program docs: <link to the page that publishes the form questions and the window>
reverify: Check the program docs' last-updated date. If it is newer than `verified`, update `forms`, `dimensions`, and `verified` before running.
Confirm the cycle window and deadlines; set `cycle.status` to `official` once published.
principles: Reviews are evidence-based: observable outcomes over stated ones.

self.text: Share up to 2 examples of work from the last 6 months. What did you deliver, and what changed because of it?
What support would help you grow your impact?
Anything else your reviewers should know?

peer.text: Would you want [NAME] on your next critical project?

notes: There is no peer free-text box.

categories.name: Impact levels
categories.note: The manager's call, not the reviewer's. Use only to sanity-check evidence strength.

levels.name: Exceptional
levels.bar: Impact well beyond own scope, with measurable results

levels.name: Strong
levels.bar: Consistently delivers high-quality work with clear results

levels.name: Solid
levels.bar: Reliably delivers what the role requires

deliver.self: I deliver work that solves the real problem
deliver.peer: Delivers work that solves the real problem
deliver.question: Does {S} identify the real need and deliver a change that addresses it, closing the work out (merged, released, verified)?
deliver.shortfall: work stalled, missed the real need, or was left unfinished

quality.self: My work is careful and well tested
quality.peer: Their work is careful and well tested
quality.question: Does {S} show care for quality: tests, validation, clear documentation, safe rollouts, or thorough reviews?
quality.shortfall: quality gap: missing tests or validation, errors, or a careless review

collaborate.self: I make the people around me more effective
collaborate.peer: Makes the people around them more effective
collaborate.question: Does {S} help others move faster or do better work: unblocking, teaching, sharing context, or giving useful feedback?
collaborate.shortfall: blocked others, withheld context, or was hard to work with

reliable.instructions: Does this item show {S} being someone others can rely on for hard, high-stakes work?
reliable.report: Reliability signals for the 'next critical project' question

people: Resolve a subject's full name, title, team, GitHub login, and Slack user id from the org directory. Role string = title + team.

collect.name: wiki
steps: Export the subject's wiki pages for the buffered collection window to raw/wiki.md.
Convert each page to one item in the item schema (id, source "wiki-page", url, date, title, workstream, text with the subject's lines prefixed '<First>:') and write items/wiki.jsonl.

notes: List the classifier ids you can use with `models.getAvailableOfType("classifier")`; the model must support `bool` and `choice` questions.
